hero.title: Sites already online. Try them before you decide.
hero.lead: Every template is a real, deployed site you can open and browse right now. We then tailor it to your business: your copy, your photos, your colours, your domain name.
hero.note: Demonstration projects: they show what we can do and act as a starting point for your site. They are not client engagements.

howItWorks.title: From template to your site, in four steps.

steps.title: You choose
steps.text: Open the demos, try them on your phone, pick the one that fits your business.

steps.title: We adapt it
steps.text: Your copy, your photos, your colours, your logo. The template becomes your site, not a recognisable copy.

steps.title: We launch
steps.text: Domain name, hosting, professional mailbox, baseline SEO. Everything set up in your name.

steps.title: You stay in control
steps.text: Hands-on training, and the choice to run the site yourself or leave it with us.

labels.priceNote: Indicative price, to be confirmed against your actual needs.

horizon-travel.name: Horizon Travel
horizon-travel.tagline: A high-end website that sells the dream without cheapening it.
horizon-travel.intent: Every travel agency shows the same beach photos. We went the other way: full-bleed imagery, editorial typography, destinations presented like a magazine spread. Luxury comes from space, not from clutter.
horizon-travel.for: Travel agencies, tour operators, boutique hotels and any business whose product sells through imagery first.
included: Domain name and hosting for the first year

fitzone.name: FitZone
fitzone.tagline: A fitness tracking app that makes people want to come back tomorrow.
fitzone.intent: Most fitness apps drown the user in numbers. Here, a single screen answers the only question that matters: what am I doing today? Everything else is one gesture away.
fitzone.for: Gyms, personal trainers, yoga studios and anyone who wants to stay useful between two sessions.
customizable: Your brand and colours inside the app
The features you keep or remove
included: Developer accounts set up in your name

soundwave.name: SoundWave
soundwave.tagline: An online store built for products people compare before buying.
soundwave.intent: Audio gear sells on the product page: specifications, comparison, reviews. We built the store around that page, and cut the checkout down to three screens.
soundwave.for: Specialist retailers, brands with a technical catalogue, resellers looking to leave marketplaces behind.
customizable: Your pricing, stock and shipping rules

greenenergy.name: GreenEnergy
greenenergy.tagline: A client portal to track installations, consumption and site visits.
greenenergy.intent: A business tool does not have to be grim. The same dashboards, given hierarchy and purposeful colour, become readable at a glance — including on a phone out in the field.
greenenergy.for: Installers, technical maintenance companies, operators and any business with assets to track and clients to keep informed.
features: Client portal with documents and contracts
customizable: Connections to the tools you already use
